json.originalInput: Can I receive SSDI benefits if I have a back injury in Arkansas?
json.aiOutput: Can I receive SSDI benefits if I have a back injury in Arkansas? If you have a back injury that prevents you from working, you may be eligible for Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) benefits. To qualify, your back injury must be severe enough that it limits your ability to perform substantial gainful activity (SGA). The Social Security Administration (SSA) evaluates back injuries under its listing of impairments to determine eligibility. You will need to provide medical documentation from your treating physicians that supports the severity of your condition. Arkansas residents follow the same federal SSDI guidelines as all other states.
